title: guard
description: Evaluates a condition in simple, xpath or jsonpath and passes the message on if it holds, or fails with a GuardError.

language.title: Language
language.description: Condition language: simple, xpath or jsonpath

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: Condition that must hold for the message to continue

message.title: Deny message
message.description: Reason reported in GuardError when the condition does not hold

interceptor.title: Interceptor
interceptor.description: Name of the guard interceptor, if woven

targetStep.title: Target step
targetStep.description: ID of the step guarded by this interceptor, if woven
